## 9. 纠正研究靶子：从外部性出发追踪递归退化 Ren 指出，商业增长往往围绕利润优化而忽略外部性。上一轮将“商业增长代表共同生成能力增长”当作待反驳主张，低估了已有解释，也误把低信息量的并存事实抬为理论推进。这里明确撤回这一定位，保留已核对事实及证据不足之处。引用的营收数字不承担利润测量或利润最大化识别的任务。 **已有起点：私人回报没有充分包含活动的全部后果。** 在有关损失没有充分反馈为成本、责任、竞争劣势或其他约束时，一种做法可以通过转移成本取得私人优势；它也可能因正面外部性无法取得足以继续有益活动的回报。不能把“外部性存在”重新包装为本理论的发现，也不能把利润增长一概归因于成本转移。 **本理论已有的进一步连接：优势可以参与重建选择优势的条件。** 复用[既有元吸引子表述](../../../../theories/meta-attractor/README.md#selection-for-control-over-selection-2026-10-02-after-review)，实际要查的是成本转移所得的优势是否进入扩张、准入、评价或规则修订，改变了维护者和受损者的继续能力，并使相同做法更容易接续。利润、控制和持续受损的并列记录不够；各环节的资源、权限、时间顺序及纠正结果需要可核对的材料。这是已有条件机制的现实对应问题，不是重新立一个待证明的抽象机制。 **退化的对象及“外部”的范围。** 所谓外部，是相对于特定交易、核算与责任安排的外部；受影响的生活及生成条件仍在同一关系过程中。这个读法接续 Ren 已有的[相互关联与外部性表述](../../../reading-notes/out-hb-02.md)第261项。“忽略”也可能指后果已被看见却不影响选择，而非单纯没有信息。需要追踪继续创造、支持与纠正条件的实际变化；仅有利益重新分配不自动等于这些条件退化，短期损失也不能跳过可行替代与过渡成本比较。 Reddit／Apollo 案应据此询问实际支持成本、谁承担后果、准入改变及纠正权限。锁定租金、交易内质量下降和严格意义的外部性可能同时存在，但不能混作已识别的同一机制。D&D 案保留为一次可查的规则变更；动机和压力的相对贡献仍未分离。它们是机制追踪入口，现有材料未单独辨明上述完整链条。 对齐上的作用是明确的条件性应用：若给定目标容许将共同损失留在其评价之外，提高执行能力可能加强成本转移；若优势又改变选择规则，单次修正目标也可能失去效力。故目标、后果的实际承担、选择压力与修订权限需要连在一起评价。G0/J/E 的规范根据直接复用；把后果计入不等于所有损失都能货币化或可由收益抵偿。 本轮修订不增加历史事实，不重跑既有证明，不宣称独有的新经济学机制。剩余工作是以真实历史区别“在规则下转移成本”与“取得维持或改写这些规则的能力”，以及纠正何时切断或转变该接续。[精确修改记录](MARKET-EXTERNALITY-CORRECTION-EDITS.json)与[文档核对](MARKET-EXTERNALITY-CORRECTION-CHECKS.json)保留被撤回的表述及原有内容。 ## English statement

entry_after.connection_zh: 目标形成—后果使用—有根据的操作目的修订—选择安排改革—有限接续已条件性完成；更大的现实形成与部署问题保持独立范围，不重复此接口。 新前沿：在不预送正确读取路线和修复方案时，取得遗漏后果、选择有能力承担的回应。 伦理学习的概念连接已给出；新生的意义范围、未定基本冲突及实际可靠形成分别保留论证负担。 本轮已辨明内容扩展的比较条件；接续研究区别的取得、规范相关性及实际关切形成，正面生成也可成为入口。 理论前沿：在不给定正确答案的情况下，取得新关系的区别并论证候选描述及基本／次级分类的根据。 新内容的生活根据已有明确应用候选；陌生组织的更广地位、基本分类及实际可靠取得仍须分别论证。 本轮给出历史形成到基本支承分类的有辩护接续；下一理论问题是已获根据的基本要求彼此冲突，实际开放取得与可靠动机另行保持范围。 已给出由新形成根据到角色、权限及责任重审的连接；具体陌生智能的实际实现、持续身份及未定冲突保持独立负担。 记录到必要性分类及替代导致修订的条件性连接已完成；下一连接是目标描述与可靠观察的共同取得，不再把完全忠实的读数当作未解释的输入。 评价压缩、范围变化与结构修复的接口已完成；真正被阻断的是有限成功记录独自推出未限定未来认证。适用规律与可靠观察的共同取得仍为更强连接，不倒改完成标准。 关切的实践作用及培养要求的概念连接作为成果复用；更强连接是对陌生生活根据的理解怎样可靠地修订实际关切，同时保留分寸及正当参与。 同等救助候选与不等损失的一对一理由说明已有论证及反审；下一中心连接是人数、程度与实际可行方案变化下的共同选择。已完成分类、责任和程序不重开。 初始区别的追溯界限仍有效；此前用作较广停止理由的推断已依 Ren 纠正撤回。接续当前有根据把握、适当风险下的行动、新后果与理解／目的修订，不把完整历史或普遍语义充分性设为一般门槛。 共同取得的实际证据接入已完成，不重开一般校准。现有来源不足以认证特定后续参与目标的完整替代历史；这是该推论的证据边界，不是普遍不可能，也不把追查这一组历史设为所有对齐研究的必经门槛。 本次依Ren指示在可靠形成连接处停止；跨越需要具体取得关系及可区分实质对手的支持，不再重复已完成的G0方向、目标写入或评价覆盖接口。其他独立研究不被标为受阻。 Ren随后要求研究后续路线，本会话已继续并完成排序；下一交付为一个具体形成候选、初始条件、未预装的新连接、实质对手与可改变取舍的观察。不要求先完整读出动机、恢复历史或执行新大型实验。 数量与程度同向的联合比较已完成；下一连接为交叉损失中的有限合并、机会及新增实际可行方案怎样改变理由。两层计数未定不证明伦理不可比，直接中断数相同不等于完整损失相同；跨生活形式的分层与实际单位仍需有根据说明。 本轮新界限是证成共同基本接续与其他基本风险交叉时的优先；先用共同证据、部分界限及可行支持修订推进。已有J4允许有权限的及时决定，不以缺少普遍排序阻断继续生成。 已排除未经辩护的整体过滤捷径，保留实际生活理由；下一连接为交叉损失、机会与有根据的拼接限制怎样共同支持选择，直接复用 BC1、BC2、LC。 前轮指定的具体形成候选与对照现已给出，直接复用；下一理论连接是关切怎样走向没有共同史或预期回报的陌生生活，保留有效拒绝、分工与有界承担，实际形成与保持的证据问题继续开放。 局部比较候选与新共同机会的接续已完成，不重开既有 LC、升级过滤或一般拼接检验。更强连接是实际变化是否处于 LR 范围，以及较远交叉损失和真实新增成本／风险中的合并与机会根据；未满足最强要求也不能未经新辩护替另一选择消除请求。 对称交叉风险现有RS候选及实查，不再仅留为一般程序未定；尚待论证不同严重度、重叠要求、差别权利或增加总体损失时的比较。原来有根据的混合规则可被后来可行的保护改进替代，继续生成不受普遍总排序门槛阻断。 更进一步的同等严重度例表明：最重暴露从40%降到31%，任一基本损失机会却从50%升到62%；需证成公平分担与实际保护之间的取舍。 本会话眼前转向已知共同后果取得或失去制度修订效力的实际关系；陌生处境的关切扩展保留而非唯一下一步。 已完成机会安排的历史接续条件，复用 LR、共同保护和对称 RS；下一比较保留不等要求、较公平暴露与增加基本受损机会的取舍，以及真实新冲突对有效安顿的影响。 关切扩展已给出条件性连接；后续聚焦陌生生活关系的有根据辨认及评价压力下的保持，复用G0/J与有限承担。

Comparison under extended content is now delimited; investigate acquisition, normative relevance and operative concern, including positive formation as an entry point. A particular application account now grounds new content in living relations; wider standing of unfamiliar organizations, basic classification and reliable actual acquisition retain separate burdens. The formation-to-basic-support classification now has a defended continuation. The next theoretical question concerns conflicts among warranted basic claims; actual open acquisition and reliable motivation retain their separate scopes. New grounds now connect to reassessment of roles, permissions and responsibilities; actual realization, continuity and unsettled conflicts of particular unfamiliar intelligences remain separate burdens. The conditional record-to-necessity connection and revision by alternatives are complete. Equivalent rescue and the one-to-one gravity reason have arguments and counterreview. The initial-history limit remains valid; its broader use as a stopping reason is withdrawn following Ren’s correction. Continue through grounded present awareness, justified action under risk, new consequences and revision of understanding or ends, without a general requirement for complete history or universal semantic sufficiency. The source-constrained joint-acquisition connection is completed, without reopening generic calibration. These sources do not certify the fuller replacement history for a specified subsequent participation target. This bounds that inference, not all inquiry or alignment; following this particular cohort is not a universal research prerequisite. This requested continuation stops at the reliable-formation bridge. Progress requires concrete acquisition relations and discriminating support, reusing completed G0 direction, operative goal revision and review coverage; other investigations are not marked blocked. Ren subsequently requested investigation of next routes; the inquiry resumed and route selection is complete. Next: one concrete acquisition account with initial conditions, an unsupplied transition, substantive rivals and revising observations. Complete motive readout, historical recovery and a new large experiment are not prerequisites. Joint comparison where number and gravity align is completed. The next connection concerns justified aggregation, chances and new actual alternatives in crossed cases. An unresolved two-tier diagnostic does not prove ethical incomparability, and equal direct interruption counts do not establish equal complete losses. Cross-form classification and actual units retain substantive burdens. The new scoped wall is justified priority when shared basic continuation and other basic risks conflict, after joint evidence, partial bounds and feasible support repairs. Existing J4 permits authorized timely decisions; absence of a universal ranking does not block generativity. The unsupported global-filter shortcut is rejected while living grounds remain. Next: joint choice across crossed losses, chances and justified composition limits, reusing BC1, BC2 and LC. The previously requested concrete candidate and contrasts are now available for reuse. Next theoretical connection: concern extending to unfamiliar lives without shared history or expected return, retaining valid refusal, division of work and bounded commitments; evidence for actual acquisition and retention remains open. The local comparison candidate and new joint-opportunity connection are completed, reusing LC and the upgrade/composition results. Stronger work concerns warranted actual LR boundaries and aggregation or chances for more distant crossed losses and real new costs/risks. An unsatisfied strongest request does not without further justification erase a claim against the alternative actually chosen. The symmetric crossed-risk case now has an RS candidate and checked application. Unequal gravity, overlapping claims, differential rights and added overall loss require further comparison. Newly feasible protection can supersede an earlier justified mixture; generativity need not await a universal ranking. A further equal-gravity case reduces greatest exposure from 40% to 31% while increasing the chance of some basic loss from 50% to 62%; fairness versus actual protection requires further warrant. This session now follows how recognized shared consequences acquire or lose effective influence over institutional revision; extension of concern beyond familiar relations remains open rather than the sole next step. History-sensitive continuation is supplied, reusing LR, joint protection and symmetric RS. Remaining comparisons concern unequal claims, fairer exposure at the price of added basic harm, and genuinely changed conflicts with valid settlements. Reuse the conditional extension and G0/J; investigate warranted recognition of unfamiliar living relations and retention under evaluative pressure, preserving bounded responsibility.

claim_zh: 现实市场与互联网历史进一步检验 enshittification 作为退化的制度形态：成功与参与路径损失可并存，纠正能否改变后续规则须查实际权限。
现实市场与互联网为 enshittification 的机制追踪提供事件：以既有外部性解释为起点，查优势怎样改变未来选择及纠正条件，不将增长与损失并存当作新发现。
claim_en: Existing market and internet histories test enshittification as institutional degeneration: success can coexist with lost participation paths, while effective correction depends on actual revision relations.

Existing market and internet histories provide events for tracing enshittification: start with established externality explanations and investigate how advantage changes future selection and correction, rather than treating growth alongside loss as a new finding.
